Averaged over oscillation periods: $$\langle \delta p_\Phi \rangle = \left\langle \dot{\Phi} \delta\dot{\Phi} - \frac{\partial V}{\partial \Phi}\delta\Phi \right\rangle = 0$$ $$\mathbf{c_s^2(z) = 0 \quad (\text{for } z \ge z_{\text{crit}})}$$ The unbroken scalar field possesses zero pressure perturbations, clustering identically to pressureless Cold Dark Matter.

At $z = 0$, $c_s^2(0) \approx 0.35$.

2.3 Acoustic Jeans Horizon

The non-zero sound speed defines a scalar Jeans wavenumber: $$k_J(a) = \frac{a H(a)}{c_s(a)}$$ For modes inside the Jeans horizon ($k > k_J$), scalar pressure prevents gravitational collapse.
